_help: Survival rules for systems/stats.js. All rates are per second of play (paused = frozen). 1 game hour = secondsPerGameHour of play (matches the default 60x clock), which is how sleeping N hours is simulated. Meters run 0..100 where 100 is always GOOD (bladder 100 = empty). mods are fractions added together then applied as (1 + sum): -0.3 = 30% less, -1 = off. Mod keys: healthMax staminaMax healthRegen staminaRegen speed (fractions), hunger thirst energy bladder (drain speed, fractions), health (HP per second, negative = damage), noRun (1 = can't run). Effects: cure = tags that remove it (toilet, or an item's use.cure), blocks = effect ids that can't start while it runs. See SURVIVAL.md.

profile.name: Tester
profile.title: Anak petani
profile._attributes: 1..10, 5 = average. vitalitas: max HP + HP regen. ketahanan: max stamina, stamina regen, run cost. metabolisme: higher = needs drain slower. imunitas: lower chance and shorter bad effects from food.

attributes.name: Imunitas

_caps: Energy caps max stamina: below energyFullAt the cap shrinks linearly to energyMinCap at 0 energy.

conditions.name: Kenyang & segar

envConditions.name: Udara musim semi

envConditions.name: Kepanasan

envConditions.name: Kedinginan

envConditions.name: Basah kuyup
envConditions.desc: Kehujanan: stamina pulih lebih lambat, cepat ngantuk. Berteduh di gazebo / mobil atau pegang Payung.

envConditions.name: Tertimbun salju

berenergi.name: Energi buah

segar.name: Segar

bugar.name: Cukup tidur
